S: the Greek diner where they wait tables
Hand-cut chips double-fried, tossed while hot with dried oregano, lemon zest and crumbled feta, Greek diner style.
Grilled cheese sandwiches with cheddar and a little Dijon, griddled in butter, cut into soldiers.
Fozzie tries to hibernate in the woods, and a bear needs supplies

Crunchy cornflakes coated in bubbling honey butter, baked in paper cases until golden and set. Melt 90g butter with 80g sugar and 2 tbsp honey and bubble for 1 minute until frothy. Pour over 4 cups cornflakes and stir until coated. Spoon into 20 paper patty cases on a tray. Bake at 150C for 10 minutes until golden, then cool completely so they set crunchy.
M: Three slices of toast: turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.
Pete's big Greek salad with souvlaki
Pete's diner, big tomato, big olives, very Pete

Chunky tomato, cucumber, capsicum, kalamatas and a slab of feta with oregano, served with grilled lemon chicken skewers. Marinate 600g diced chicken thigh in 3 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp dried oregano for 30 minutes, thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 minutes, turning. Cut 4 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1 green capsicum and half a red onion into chunks. Add 100g kalamatas, top with a 200g slab of feta, sprinkle oregano and dress with oil and red wine vinegar.
W: the wedding that might be real
Two layers of vanilla butter cake sandwiched and covered in Swiss meringue buttercream, half tinted pink and half green, piped flowers.
K: Greek yoghurt blended with milk, honey, banana and ice into a thick frothy shake with a sprinkle of cinnamon. Peel and slice 2 ripe bananas. Blend with 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 cup ice for 45 seconds until thick and frothy. Taste and add a little more honey if needed. Pour into 4 tall glasses, drizzle each with a little more honey and dust with ground cinnamon. Serve with straws.

s.note: the Greek diner where they wait tables
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry twice, first at 140C, then at 185C. Toss while hot with 1 tsp dried oregano, the zest of a lemon, salt and 100g crumbled feta. Squeeze the lemon over just before serving.

Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and fill with 200g sliced cheddar. Butter the outsides with 40g butter and griddle over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into soldiers.

m.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices bread. Layer 300g sliced turkey, bacon, lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes with mayo across three slices for each sandwich. Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles. Serve with potato chips.

w.note: the wedding that might be real
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, split and tint half pink and half green. Ice and pipe flowers.

d.how: Peel and slice 2 ripe bananas. Blend with 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 cup ice for 45 seconds until thick and frothy. Taste and add a little more honey if needed. Pour into 4 tall glasses, drizzle each with a little more honey and dust with ground cinnamon. Serve with straws.
